This is the second bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. moved by the applicant - Sachin to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No. 36 of 2022 under Sections 376 I.P.C. and 3A/4 POCSO Act,

opennyai_summary.arguments:
The incident is said to have taken place in he 'gher' of the accused, which shows that the victim is a consenting party.
Moreover, the house of the victim and applicant- Sachin are at a quite far distance, so it cannot be said that the victim was dragged by the accused from her house to his 'gher' and the rape was committed on her.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer of bail and submitted that all the grounds taken by the learned counsel for the applicant at this stage have already been considered vide order dated 29.08.2022.
The victim has supported the prosecution case in her statement in the court also.
Hence bail application is prayed to be rejected.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
Though, it is claimed that the benefit of two years of age relaxation must be given to the accused at this stage but in the opinion of the court even if the relaxation of two years is considered in favour of the applicant it does not absolve him from accusation of committing rape on the victim.
The incident with the victim in 'gher' of the accused cannot itself prove victim a consenting party.
The victim has supported the prosecution version in her on oath statement before the court.
Thus, after perusing the record in the light of submission advanced at the bar, taking overall view of the facts and circumstances of the case, the nature of accusation and the period of detention already undergone without commenting on the merit of the case, I do not find it a fit case for bail.
opennyai_summary.decision:
The second bail application of the applicant is hereby rejected.
However, the trial court is directed to expedite the hearing and decide the case being Case Crime No.
36 of 2022 under Sections 376 I.P.C. and 3A/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Nanauta, District Saharanpur, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of ten months from the date of producing a certified copy of this order.
